coder_notes: Basket of EGFR-altered NSCLC and recurrent GBM; GBM eligible only in Phase 1 dose escalation (named in title and arm label). EGFR alteration is an entry requirement for every cohort (NSCLC EGFR mutations; GBM EGFR amplification/mutation/variant), hence eligibility with arms empty; it is the GBM requirement quoted. Phase 2 Cohort 3 arm lists no interventions, so not added to agent arms. Registered inclusion criteria text covers Phase 2 NSCLC only. PK is plasma only.
